title: Alan's Auto
body:
(Old Alan's Auto is the closed part of the Alan's AutoLogistics shop located in Finlay owned by Alan Burk. Alan's Auto only has one item for sale, that being the Fever Vinyl for $600. It's unknown if this part of the shop is going to get used for something else in future updates. The interior of the closed shop has the same layout as the opened part of Alan's AutoLogistics exept for the walls having streets on the wall as some sort of decoration. At the back of the shop there's a broken window where you can enter the shop to access it.)

Alan's Auto was changed in the Shift in Terrain update. in the new update you can now buy Traffic Cones and the Freyliner Transporter. The Fever Vinyl is now located in the roof supports inside of the building.

This table shows all items available at the store.
